content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. The pricing structure (p0056–p0063), payment terms, and general provisions contain no obligation on Licensee to extend best terms, and the only third-party-comparison mechanic is Licensor's Right of First Refusal on a sale of Licensee (a separate change-of-control term, not an MFN).

input.rationale: The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind. Fees are set by a fixed tiered per-US$1m schedule (p0056–p0063) with no requirement that Licensee offer Licensor rates or terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match third-party offers; the fee, supplemental payment (p0078), support (p0086–p0089) and general provisions sections are all silent on comparison to other counterparties. The only third-party-comparison mechanic is Licensor's Right of First Refusal over a sale or merger of Licensee (p0139), which is a change-of-control right rather than an MFN on commercial terms and is addressed under the assignment/change-of-control rules, not here. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer). We note the flip side — Licensor grants us no MFN pricing either — but that is an upside ask, not a deviation, so no redline is proposed.
